$description: Run-trace card contract (wave-XI W2.1, Copilot mechanisms) — ToolCallCard and SubagentCard: chrome components on themed surfaces, status colors via statusVar/state.* dictionary, nesting shown by indent + edge, never by invented colors.

bg.$description: Card ground — one step above the feed so nested depth is visible.

nestEdge.$description: Left edge marking a call nested under parentCallId — accent hairline, not a new color.

nestIndent.$description: Indent per nesting level under the parent tool call.

meta.$description: Duration / callId / timestamps — mono meta tone.

fontMono.$description: Payload and duration — IBM Plex Mono per type contract.

badgeBg.$description: Subagent badge wash — violet marks a delegated isolated run.

summaryEdge.$description: Edge of the collapsed summary card — only the final result returns to the parent feed.

axis.$description: Vertical time axis of the run-trajectory panel — neutral, never accent.

axisOffset.$description: Horizontal distance between the axis and the card column; children add toolCall.nestIndent per level under it.

dot.$description: Axis node of a live/running call — accent only for the in-flight one; status colors of nodes come from statusVar(state), this is the neutral default.

dotRing.$description: Pulse ring on the running node.

time.$description: Timestamps on the axis — IBM Plex Mono via toolCall.fontMono.

groupEdge.$description: Bracket edge grouping a parent's children on the axis — same gold thread as toolCall.nestEdge.
